01 / ABOUT VISION

Knowledge meets
opportunity.

A complete career and skill-development platform—from career guidance and admission to skill training, internships and job opportunities.

Vision Institute & Consultancy, Indore, established in 2016, is an education, skill development and career guidance institution dedicated to helping students and professionals build the knowledge, skills and confidence required for academic and professional success.

We combine career counselling, admission guidance, skill-based training, professional courses, internships and job consultancy to create a complete pathway from learning to employment.

Our approach focuses on practical learning, industry-relevant skills and personalised guidance so every learner can make informed career decisions and move confidently towards their goals.

Vision Institute operates as a unit of Khushhali Sewa Sansthan, with an emphasis on accessible, practical and career-oriented education.

OUR CORE AREAS
  • Career & Educational Counselling
  • Admission Consultancy
  • Computer & IT Skill Training
  • Professional & Job-Oriented Courses
  • Online & Offline Courses
  • Online & Offline Internships
  • Job Consultancy & Placement Support
  • Resume & Interview Preparation
  • Digital Skills & Emerging Technologies
  • Personality & Soft Skills Development

Our aim is simple — the right direction, relevant skills and meaningful opportunities for every learner.

02 / DIRECTOR'S MESSAGE

Guidance can turn uncertainty into confidence.

“Education is not merely about obtaining a certificate; it is about developing the knowledge, confidence, skills and values required to create a meaningful future.”

At Vision Institute, our endeavour is to bridge the gap between education and employability through practical learning, career guidance and opportunities relevant to today's professional world.

Every student has unique abilities and potential. The right guidance at the right time can transform aspirations into achievable goals.

  • Career-oriented and practical education
  • Personalised career counselling

  • Online and offline learning opportunities
  • Internship and practical exposure
